findings.problem: The hint rules out hier but not hierher, which is a common word that also fits "come here" with movement toward the speaker (Komm hierher!).
findings.fix: hint: toward me, with movement: come here (the short word, not hier or hierher)

back.target: here, over here (toward the speaker, with movement; hither)

note: The Spanish card aca-here means "here" in general rather than "toward the speaker", so leaving sameAs null is reasonable.
